title: Articles
seoDescription: Peer-reviewed articles by Huseyin Zeyd Koytak.
content:
Peer-reviewed publications.

- Suleyman Kiroglu & **Huseyin Zeyd Koytak** (2026). [Rural notables, professionals, and ideologues: The social bases of AKP local power](https://doi.org/10.1080/23745118.2026.2620579). *European Politics and Society*.
- Huzeyfe Ayaz, Muhammed Hasan Celik, **Huseyin Zeyd Koytak**, & Ibrahim Emre Yanik (2024). [Exploring vaccine hesitancy in digital public discourse: From tribal polarization to socio-economic disparities](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0308122). *PLOS ONE*, 19(11), e0308122. *(Co-first and co-corresponding author.)*
- Suleyman Kiroglu & **Huseyin Zeyd Koytak** (2024). [Mapping solidarity: Organizational density of hometown associations of Istanbul](https://doi.org/10.1080/14683849.2024.2340497). *Turkish Studies*. *(Co-first and corresponding author.)*
- **Huseyin Zeyd Koytak** (2024). [Ethnicity on the table: A content analysis of online reviews for Syracuse's cuisines](https://doi.org/10.1111/soc4.13195). *Sociology Compass*, e13195.
- **Huseyin Zeyd Koytak** & Muhammed Hasan Celik (2022). [A text mining approach to determinants of attitude towards Syrian immigration in the Turkish Twittersphere](https://doi.org/10.1177/08944393221117460). *Social Science Computer Review*. *(Co-first and corresponding author.)*
- Jennifer Karas Montez, Jason Beckfield, Julene Cooney, Mark D. Hayward, Jacob M. Grumbach, **Huseyin Zeyd Koytak**, Steven Woolf, & Anna Zajacova (2020). [Policies, politics, and U.S. life expectancy](https://doi.org/10.1111/1468-0009.12469). *The Milbank Quarterly*, 98(3), 668–699. *(Honorable Mention, ASA Distinguished Contribution to Scholarship in Population, 2021.)*
